description: Fetch one frozen executive-report snapshot by its public share token (the token IS the capability). Returns the STORED snapshot only — never recomputed — plus its snapshot_hash and methodology_version integrity stamps. Response is envelope-shaped: every numeric leaf is a MeasuredValue {value, ci_low, ci_high, method, data_through}. ci fields are null unless the source payload carries a real confidence interval — never fabricated. Requires an API key with the 'read' scope.

share_token.description: The report share token (16–64 lowercase hex chars)

name: metrx_get_report_snapshot
title: Get Report Snapshot
